seo.title: Hyundai Motor India: omnichannel conversational agent (Yellow.ai) - 1000+ sales (2022)
seo.meta_description: Hyundai Motor India's omnichannel conversational agent (Yellow.ai) generated more than 1000 vehicle sales and more than 1 million customer impressions.
seo.resume_citable: Hyundai Motor India's omnichannel conversational agent (Yellow.ai, on web, WhatsApp, Facebook, and Google Business Messages) contributed to more than 1000 vehicle sales and more than one million impressions across 14 outbound campaigns, with a 22-second average helpdesk response time.

faq.q: What business results did Hyundai India get with its conversational agent?
faq.a: More than 1000 vehicle sales generated and more than one million impressions across 14 outbound campaigns, with a 22-second average helpdesk response time, according to the Yellow.ai case study.

faq.q: On which channels is the agent present?
faq.a: Website, WhatsApp, Facebook, and Google Business Messages, with an outbound campaign module on WhatsApp and a helpdesk for human handoff.

objectif_business: Turn online interest into test drives and sales: let prospects explore models, choose a trim, and book a test drive via a conversational agent available on the channels where Indian buyers are, and feed personalized outbound campaigns.
description: Hyundai Motor India deployed with Yellow.ai an omnichannel conversational agent (website, WhatsApp, Facebook, Google Business Messages) that lets the customer explore the lineup, choose a trim, and book a test drive. The Engage module serves personalized WhatsApp campaigns; the helpdesk module equips human agents for service. The setup combines automated purchase journeys and outbound campaigns measured through real-time dashboards. On the published results for this period: sales generated, campaign impression volume, and average helpdesk response time.
points_cles: Omnichannel conversational commerce and lead-gen agent (exploration, trim, test drive).
Yellow.ai (DynamicNLP, Engage module, helpdesk) on web, WhatsApp, Facebook, and GBM.
1000+ vehicle sales, 1 million+ impressions, 22-second average response time.
Evidence level B, living status mixed signals.

resultats.metrique: Vehicle sales generated via the agent (automated journeys + outbound campaigns)

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified case study from the vendor Yellow.ai (interested party) with sales and conversion metrics, corroborated by Indian press confirming the deployment of a Hyundai India AI chatbot on its online sales site. Data from the 2022 period.

stack_technique.detail: Omnichannel conversational AI platform that carries the commerce agent on the website, WhatsApp, Facebook, and Google Business Messages
The platform's NLP engine that understands prospect requests without intent-by-intent training
Module for personalized outbound campaigns on WhatsApp, 14 campaigns and more than one million impressions over the period
Main conversion and campaign channel in India, operated through the platform
Equips human agents to take over on service, with an average response time of 22 seconds

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on inbound channels; scheduled outbound campaigns (monthly) on WhatsApp.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Hyundai Motor India's digital marketing and CRM team, on the Yellow.ai platform, with human agents as backup via the helpdesk.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Conversation behavior and conversion events (test drive booked, trim chosen). Without opt-in and clean segmentation, the WhatsApp outbound campaigns lose relevance and deliverability.

etapes.detail: The prospect engages the agent on the site, WhatsApp, Facebook, or Google Business Messages.
The agent helps explore the lineup, choose a trim, and offers to book a test drive.
The Engage module sends personalized WhatsApp campaigns to targeted segments.
The helpdesk lets agents take over for personalized resolutions.
Real-time dashboards track conversions, sales, and campaign performance.

prerequis_orga: handoff process to dealerships and service
stack_possible: Yellow.ai or a conversational agent platform
replication.premiere_etape: Connect a conversational agent to the site and WhatsApp with a test-drive booking journey tied to the CRM.

playbook.action: Frame the target journey (lineup exploration, trim choice, test-drive booking) and prepare the product catalog and the opt-in prospect base.
playbook.livrable: Specified conversational journey and a ready opt-in base

playbook.action: Configure the agent on the conversational platform, deploy it on the site and WhatsApp, and connect test-drive booking to the CRM and dealerships.
playbook.livrable: Agent in production on two channels with leads flowing to the CRM

playbook.action: Launch the first WhatsApp outbound campaigns on opt-in target segments and activate the helpdesk for human handoff.
playbook.livrable: Active campaigns and an escalation circuit to agents in place

playbook.action: Track lead-to-retail conversion, booked test drives, and campaign performance in the dashboards, and adjust segments and journey.

replication.equipe: 1 CRM / digital project lead + 1 conversation designer (or the platform's editor) + dealership and customer service backup

statut_vivant.note: The deployment of a Hyundai India AI chatbot is attested by the press; the quantified metrics come from a vendor case study of the 2022 period, without a recent quantified confirmation.

transposable_ue.note: Relies heavily on WhatsApp as a conversion channel, dominant in India. In the EU, marketing opt-in consent (GDPR) is required for outbound campaigns and the channel mix needs to be adapted.
